messages:
Aisha (CSM): FYI seeing a sharp drop for Kepler.ai  ~60% MoM on API calls and seats. Renewal in ~45 days. Procurement note mentions Vega. Need quick triage and playbook.
Ravi (AM): Do we have raw numbers? top routes?
Aisha (CSM): Quick peek:
```
last_30d_calls: 24k
prev_30d_calls: 62k
active_seats: 12 -> 5
top_routes: /summaries, /fine-tune-infer
```
Marta (Solutions Eng): Any infra incidents or SLO blips?
Aisha (CSM): No SLO breaches; 99p latency steady. Sam said procurement is comparing costs + latency to Vega.
Jordan (GTM): Confirmed: Vega running a small POC from their procurement note. Likely price/terms play.
Ravi (AM): Proposed triage: 1) Outreach to new procurement contact Elena + CTO consultant 2) Rapid perf + cost A/B on their top routes 3) Offer a short reserved pilot + credit 4) Escalate to enterprise if RFP drops. Who owns outreach?
Aisha (CSM): Ill reach out today. Jordan - can you draft pricing delta? Marta - can you run perf A/B?
Marta (Solutions Eng): Will run 2-route perf test to mimic Vega config. 1-2 hours.
Jordan (GTM): I'll assemble a pricing brief and suggested pilot terms (2-week reserved pool + 10% credit).
OpsBot: alert: customer-usage-drop detected for kepler.ai (30d). Ticket CS-9876 created.
Marta (Solutions Eng): Perf run done: /summaries median p99 220ms on our hosted v2 quantized vs 260ms Vega-like baseline. Token cost est: our unit ~0.045 vs Vega ~0.052 per 1k tokens. Raw logs uploaded to GDrive.
Jordan (GTM): Pricing brief uploaded. Emphasized predictable reserved throughput, rollout controls, and private deployment options. Added TCO slide.
Aisha (CSM): Outreach draft to Elena: "Hi Elena  saw procurement note — were seeing a dip and would like to offer a short pilot + cost comparison. Can we do 30m Thu?  Aisha"
Ravi (AM): Tweak: propose two times, mention Marta on the call, offer token-level spend breakdown.
Aisha (CSM): Sent (Elena replied available Thu 2pm). Added Marta + Jordan.
Ravi (AM): Action items recap: outreach - Aisha (done); perf brief - Marta (done); pricing & pilot terms - Jordan (done); schedule + QBR prep - Aisha/Ravi. Check back after the call. :thumbsup:
Aisha (CSM): If procurement signals an RFP, we escalate to enterprise sales. Keep updates here.
